findings: Amendment reviewed 2026-10-28: the new decision display scenario requires each run section of the status page to show why the run ended as it did. anvil/statuspage.py renders the recorded approver and human gate rule sentences when the report carries a decision object, and for older reports without one it derives a minimal explanation from the recorded verdict, the human_required flag and the executed reviewer steps, labeled derived from the run record so it is never mistaken for the runner's own words. Tests cover both the recorded and the derived path.
